title: with-slate: Unhandled Runtime Error Error: Cannot find a descendant at path [0] in node

labels.name: examples

labels.name: bug

body:
### What example does this report relate to?

with-slate

### What version of Next.js are you using?

11.1.2

### What version of Node.js are you using?

14.15.3

### What browser are you using?

Chrome

### What operating system are you using?

macOS

### How are you deploying your application?

npm run dev

### Describe the Bug

Example throws a runtime error occurs upon hot reload

`Unhandled Runtime Error`
`Error: Cannot find a descendant at path [0] in node: {"children":[],"operations":[],"selection":null,"marks":null,"history":{"undos":[],"redos":[]}}`

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5891137/136570176-427a630d-936e-4791-b191-65fd3e7970f6.png)


### Expected Behavior

Should not have a runtime error upon hot reload

### To Reproduce

- `git clone git@github.com:vercel/next.js.git`
- `cd next.js/examples/with-slate`
- `npm i`
- `npm run dev`
- view http://localhost:3000 in Chrome
- trigger a hot reload by making some change to index.js (like adding whitespace) and saving the file
- observe a runtime error:
`Unhandled Runtime Error`
`Error: Cannot find a descendant at path [0] in node: {"children":[],"operations":[],"selection":null,"marks":null,"history":{"undos":[],"redos":[]}}`

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5891137/136570176-427a630d-936e-4791-b191-65fd3e7970f6.png)
